description: This file is a script used for analyzing TypeScript project files to detect plugin extension import boundary violations, specifically to prevent improper imports from bundled plugin files into 'src/plugins'. It contains functions to collect inventory data, perform diff comparisons, and generate human-readable reports.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries based on file, line, kind, specifier, and reason for sorting purposes.

methods.name: classifyResolvedExtensionReason
methods.description: Classifies the reason for an import based on its resolved path and import kind, indicating if it's an extension implementation, entry point, or owned file from src/plugins.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry object to the entries array.

methods.name: scanImportBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Scans a TypeScript source file for import boundary violations related to plugin extension boundaries, returning an array of entries.

methods.name: scanWebSearchRegistrySmells
methods.description: Detects specific web search provider registry smells in the 'src/plugins/web-search-providers.ts' file, returning relevant entries.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether to skip processing some files based on their path patterns.

methods.name: collectPluginExtensionImportBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Collects inventory data about plugin extension import boundary violations across project files, with caching.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the expected inventory JSON from baseline file, with caching.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes the difference between expected and actual inventory entries.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory into a human-readable string report.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a string.

methods.name: runPluginExtensionImportBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the baseline inventory check for plugin extension import boundaries.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point executing the import boundary check script.
